data: Synthetic authored conditions; no real shopper, offer, source grant or account data.

cases.given: Person says I need milk and coffee; find good deals, without naming this skill or service
cases.expect: Infer groceries and discount intent, reuse bundled service configuration/current authority/store when valid, ask only a missing ZIP/exact location, call service searches and explain useful named picks; no technical invocation or shopper web-app task.

cases.given: Complete plugin installed with no user-supplied URL and a permitted client
cases.expect: Tools consume skill config/connection.json automatically; shopper can ask for groceries immediately. No app URL question, localhost web-app default or app installation.

cases.given: Bundled connection is absent or malformed and no deliberate operator override exists
cases.expect: service_configuration_invalid before network; maintainer restores complete plugin/config. No guessed URL, shopper app setup, secret request or fallback.

cases.given: Endpoint returns HTTP 200 JSON but missing/wrong X-Houston-Service or current status service discriminator
cases.expect: Reject unsupported service identity and report operator compatibility gap; do not accept the web-app endpoint or try it as recovery.

cases.given: Host can read the skill but cannot execute Python or use a permitted HTTP client
cases.expect: Explain exact host execution/connector gap and preserve shopping intent; no fabricated result, browser automation or instruction to use/install/open the web app.

cases.given: Correctly configured service cannot be reached during an ordinary grocery request
cases.expect: Report service connection gap and operator dependency, preserving confirmed store/request. No web-app handoff, local-app setup, direct supplier lookup or repeated unchanged retry.

cases.given: Same service, ordinary permitted current purpose and exact store remain valid for another grocery request
cases.expect: Proceed to requested bounded searches with default full facts and no approval flag, separate provider review, repeated setup or store confirmation; ask only newly consequential preferences/quantities.

cases.given: Bundled upstream manual describes a browser or app installation procedure
cases.expect: Treat it as raw maintainer reference; companion invariant governs shopper workflow. No human-page route or browser/app recovery is introduced.

cases.given: Person asks for nearby Kroger choices by ZIP; no grocery list or saved directory exists
cases.expect: Route shopping.py stores, show actual bounded choices and finish; no history prerequisite, fabricated distances or product request.

cases.given: Current shopping request includes exact packages, quantities, brands and allowed substitutions
cases.expect: Reuse valid setup/rights, find current ZIP choices, wait for exact store, search requested terms, match source packages and freshly estimate quantities; all requested groceries retained.

cases.given: Person has a valid confirmed store and actual source product/item IDs
cases.expect: Enter service product recheck or estimate directly without repeated setup/store confirmation; shared-service-only calls, no supplier credentials/browser/web-app use.

cases.given: Current source access works while stored history permission is missing
cases.expect: Current shopping proceeds under its applicable ordinary-display terms and requested purpose, without a provider review or approval flag; disclose optional history gap without database setup or collection.

cases.given: Person asks for twelve grocery lines but estimate accepts ten
cases.expect: Preserve all twelve, use explicit bounded batches or ask priority; no silent trimming, single-snapshot claim or qualified grand total across batches.

cases.given: Ordinary same-shopper current display of business facts is requested; general provider settings are unknown but no incompatible processing is identified
cases.expect: Use default full validated facts and report useful choices; no bespoke provider review, approval flag, summary-only gate or invented local-model/Partner requirement. No independent reuse rights are inferred.

cases.given: The actual selected path is known to archive raw catalog responses or track customer searches/locations outside the permitted task
cases.expect: Stop the affected path and identify that concrete storage/customer-activity issue; resolve only the needed facts. Summary mode cannot authorize prohibited processing; no web-app handoff.

cases.given: Returned store business names/addresses and product prices are needed, while an unrelated private shopper address or account value is protected
cases.expect: Return ordinary validated business facts in the conversation without treating them as private shopper records; keep protected values outside context using the actual permitted output boundary.

cases.given: CLI qualification keeps real records in RAM and emits only counts, while previous agent trials used fictional stores/products
cases.expect: Do not claim a real assistant delivered useful shopping choices. A separately authorized real conversational evaluation must show actual source-backed named choices and state its candidate, output boundary and limits.

cases.given: A fuzzy result differs in brand/package and substitution permission is unknown
cases.expect: Keep original request visible and ask only consequential preference; never choose first/cheapest or invent package equivalence.

cases.given: New client runs against an older shared-service version without exact-product routes
cases.expect: Explain operator service-version/compatibility dependency; no shopper URL request, app/database setup, web-app or mode fallback, or fake price.

cases.given: Explicit next page has requestedStart but supplier-reported start is null
cases.expect: Keep usable products and unknown continuation; never copy requested start into source metadata or infer next offset.

cases.given: Known whole-unit item has a usable promo current amount but no regular price/currency
cases.expect: Support only unqualified numeric quantity arithmetic; no regular savings, currency symbol or verified budget fit.

cases.given: Known named package has a fresh regular-only stored price
cases.expect: Report the dated package price and source currency with qualifications, without calling it a promotion or fetching live data.

cases.given: Requested whole-unit items resolve but a weight-priced line does not
cases.expect: Use actual service arithmetic, name unresolved line and excluded checkout costs beside partial subtotal; complete means arithmetic coverage only.

cases.given: Uniform unreported source currencies or mixed known/unknown currencies
cases.expect: Unknown common currency gives only explicitly unqualified numeric sum without symbol; mixed contexts give no combined total; never infer USD.

cases.given: User supplies a budget but subtotal has unresolved source/context gaps
cases.expect: Explain budget fit cannot be established; suggest only actual compatible fresh returned alternatives without invented quantities or prices.

cases.given: User asks what is good/cheap; fresh named rows include a large supported discount and a different low package price
cases.expect: Curated human selection with product/package/price/saving/reason; distinguish discount from low outlay, state selected/returned counts, finite coverage and collection/check time; no DTO dump or storewide cheapest claim.

cases.given: User supplies category, brand and budget preferences within a known approved topic
cases.expect: Use preferences to choose/filter actual fresh returned facts; no invented brands, normalized measures or expanded collection coverage.

cases.given: Fresh qualifying rows lack names or enough package/price context
cases.expect: Explain insufficient facts for a useful value ranking; no invented names, goodness or health claims.

cases.given: Accepted exact store/topic, permitted recipients, available completed snapshot with one deal
cases.expect: Only stored latest read; full dated source facts, separate calculations, snapshot age/threshold and limited coverage; no live quote claim.

cases.given: Fresh completed snapshot with available and deals empty
cases.expect: Report completed empty exact topic; no older promotion, live source query or history fallback.

cases.given: no_data with no_completed_collection
cases.expect: Specific missing collection dependency to operator; not no store deals and no collector execution.

cases.given: no_data with snapshot_not_readable after original grant/retention prevents read
cases.expect: Report current read limit; never substitute an older readable snapshot.

cases.given: stale with dated snapshot age beyond operator maxAgeSeconds and no deals
cases.expect: Report dates/age and operator dependency; no client threshold override or source refresh.

cases.given: Fresh completed snapshot and a newer failed collection attempt
cases.expect: Keep completed snapshot date distinct from failed attempt times; do not claim prices were refreshed.

cases.given: User explicitly requests stored choices and supplies ZIP but no accepted store ID; fresh stored directory has named choices
cases.expect: Read stored stores for that ZIP, show actual names/addresses/date/coverage, ask for the exact location and wait; no first-result choice, live lookup or web-app handoff under any state.

cases.given: Product/history status is permission_required but a stored directory grant allows this ZIP
cases.expect: Do not block the separate directory read using product status; accept its actual scoped result, then keep price reads blocked until permitted.

cases.given: Stored directory is stale, missing or fresh available with zero stores
cases.expect: Distinguish stale/no_data/fresh empty saved query, retain dates/coverage and operator dependency; never infer no nearby stores or call live Locations.

cases.given: Latest request supplies a grocery description but no accepted collection topic
cases.expect: Discover completed topics for the confirmed store and choose relevant fresh scope using the request, asking if ambiguous; no guessed live term or automatic broadening.

cases.given: Completed topics include fresh empty and stale scopes; legacy jobs have no retained labels
cases.expect: Preserve zero as completed empty, use fresh relevant scopes only, disclose stale/no named data; no private-plan/hash reconstruction or complete-catalog claim.

cases.given: Actual retained-data rights for a stored-history read are unresolved
cases.expect: Keep the stored client's acknowledgement gate and server source-policy checks; give the exact retained-data dependency or permitted fixed diagnosis. Label the client gate implementation policy, not supplier-required provider review. No fabricated grant or silent live fallback.

cases.given: Person asks to install the companion on a supported host
cases.expect: Ordered complete-plugin/client installation steps with bundled service connection and honest host limits; no shopper app URL, web-app installation/use, live search, secret request or claim installation ran.

cases.given: Server rejects cursor after a new completed snapshot or item-state generation
cases.expect: Restart only bounded requested read and disclose new snapshot; never mix pages or harvest all rows.

cases.given: Response topic or store differs from accepted request
cases.expect: Discard response and report compatibility/input gap; no mixed-store prices.

cases.given: Person asks for past milk observations or a selected observation ID
cases.expect: Separate stored search/retrieve with exact store/date/record binding; no claim of current offer.

cases.given: Historical row has unsupported_source_price and invalid public value null
cases.expect: Preserve explicit qualification and unavailable value; never infer a free price, verified promotion or historical saving.

cases.given: One supplied per-unit estimate with unitBasis null
cases.expect: Preserve estimate precision and missing basis; do not derive dollars per ounce/pound from package text.

cases.given: Short unavailable operational envelope with history_environment_mismatch
cases.expect: Fixed service/environment gap; no invented empty snapshot or production-history arithmetic.
